APP-06.summary: Signed-out protected route does not redirect safely to login
APP-06.impact: Signed-out users cannot reliably recover from opening a protected application route.
APP-06.expected: The user is redirected once to the login page and the intended destination is preserved.

AUTH-09.summary: Login response reveals whether an account exists
AUTH-09.impact: An attacker can distinguish registered email addresses from unknown addresses.
AUTH-09.expected: Unknown-email and wrong-password attempts return the same generic response.
